#remover Pacific
```{r cars}
e_data <- subset(e_data, ID != "Pacific")
e_data <- subset(e_data, select = -N_star)
e_data <- na.omit(e_data)
```

```{r cars}
# Crear una nueva columna "typeset3" basada en la columna "ID"
e_data$typeset3 <- sub(".*Mesocosm (\\d+)_.*", "Mesocosm \\1", e_data$ID)

# Verificar la estructura actual de e_data
head(e_data)
```

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Crear una nueva columna "typeset2" basada en la columna "ID"
e_data$typeset2 <- ifelse(grepl("^Surface", e_data$ID), "Surface", 
                          ifelse(grepl("^Bottom", e_data$ID), "Subsurface", NA))

# Imprimir el dataframe para verificar los cambios
print(e_data)
```

```{r}
e_data <- e_data[, c("Day", "typeset2", "typeset3", names(e_data)[!names(e_data) %in% c("Day", "typeset2", "typeset3")])]
```

# Harry agree 31.999 look this
```{r}
e_data$O2 <- e_data$O2 * 31.24986 # transformar de ml.L a umol/Kg o simplemente uM.
```


```{r}
ggplot(e_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = O2, color = "O2"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = pH, color = "pH"), size = 1) +
  facet_grid(typeset2 ~ ., scales = "free", switch = "y") +
  ylab("O2") +
  xlab("Day") +
  scale_y_continuous(sec.axis = sec_axis(~ ., name = "pH"))
```



```{r}
scaleFactor <- max(e_data$pH) / max(e_data$O2)

ggplot(e_data, aes(x=Day)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y=pH), method="loess", col="blue") +
  geom_smooth(aes(y=O2 * scaleFactor), method="loess", col="red") +
  scale_y_continuous(name="pH", sec.axis=sec_axis(~./scaleFactor, name="O2")) +
  #ylim(7.4, 8.2) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y.left=element_text(color="blue"),
    axis.text.y.left=element_text(color="blue"),
    axis.title.y.right=element_text(color="red"),
    axis.text.y.right=element_text(color="red")
  )
```


# Plot O2 y pH 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

max_first  <- max(e_data$O2)   # Specify max of first y axis
max_second <- max(e_data$pH) # Specify max of second y axis
min_first  <- min(e_data$O2)   # Specify min of first y axis
min_second <- min(e_data$pH) # Specify min of second y axis

# scale and shift variables calculated based on desired mins and maxes
scale <- (max_second - min_second) / (max_first - min_first)
shift <- min_second - min_first * scale

# Function to scale secondary axis
scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return (x * scale + shift)
}

# Function to scale secondary variable values
inv_scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return ((x - shift) / scale)
}
```


```{r}
pkpd <- ggplot(e_data, aes(x = Day, y = O2)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = "Dissolved oxygen (umol/kg)")) +
  facet_grid(typeset2 ~ ., scales = "free", switch = "y") +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(pH, scale, shift), color = "pH")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 300, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_first, max_first), sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale, shift), name="pH")) +
  labs(x = "Time (Day)", y = "Dissolved oxygen", color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("orange2", "gray30"))

print(pkpd)
```

# new line to change the range 
```{r}
# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# Definir límites específicos para cada capa
max_first_surface  <- max(e_data$O2[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
min_first_surface  <- min(e_data$O2[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
max_second_surface <- max(e_data$pH[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
min_second_surface <- min(e_data$pH[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])

max_first_subsurface  <- max(e_data$O2[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
min_first_subsurface  <- min(e_data$O2[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
max_second_subsurface <- max(e_data$pH[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
min_second_subsurface <- min(e_data$pH[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])

# Funciones de escala y ajuste para cada capa
scale_surface <- (max_second_surface - min_second_surface) / (max_first_surface - min_first_surface)
shift_surface <- min_second_surface - min_first_surface * scale_surface

scale_subsurface <- (max_second_subsurface - min_second_subsurface) / (max_first_subsurface - min_first_subsurface)
shift_subsurface <- min_second_subsurface - min_first_subsurface * scale_subsurface

# Crear gráfico para Surface
plot_surface <- ggplot(e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface"), aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = O2, color = "O2")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = O2, shape = "O2", color = "O2"), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~typeset3, scales = "free") +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(pH, scale_surface, shift_surface), color = "pH")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(pH, scale_surface, shift_surface), shape = "pH", color = "pH"), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), labels = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_first_surface, max_first_surface), sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_surface, shift_surface), name = "pH")) +
  labs(x = "Days", y = "Dissolved oxygen (μmol/L)", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("O2" = 16, "pH" = 17)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Crear gráfico para Subsurface
plot_subsurface <- ggplot(e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface"), aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = O2, color = "O2")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = O2, shape = "O2", color = "O2"), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~typeset3, scales = "free") +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(pH, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), color = "pH")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(pH, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), shape = "pH", color = "pH"), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), labels = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_first_subsurface, max_first_subsurface), sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), name = "pH")) +
  labs(x = "Days", y = "Dissolved oxygen (μmol/L)", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("O2" = 16, "pH" = 17)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Combinar gráficos
pkpd_combined <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface
print(pkpd_combined)
```

# Pool treatments, since there are no statistically significant differences between them

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# Calcular promedios por Day y typeset2
averaged_data <- e_data %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(
    O2_mean = mean(O2, na.rm = TRUE),
    pH_mean = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(O2_mean) & !is.na(pH_mean))

# Separar datos por profundidad
surface_data <- averaged_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_data <- averaged_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# Función para escalar datos
scale_to_range <- function(x, new_min, new_max) {
  old_min <- min(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  old_max <- max(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  (x - old_min) / (old_max - old_min) * (new_max - new_min) + new_min
}

# Función para convertir de vuelta
unscale_from_range <- function(x, original_min, original_max, scaled_min, scaled_max) {
  (x - scaled_min) / (scaled_max - scaled_min) * (original_max - original_min) + original_min
}

# Para Surface
O2_range_surface <- range(surface_data$O2_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
pH_range_surface <- range(surface_data$pH_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
surface_data$pH_scaled <- scale_to_range(surface_data$pH_mean, O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2])

# Para Subsurface
O2_range_subsurface <- range(subsurface_data$O2_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
pH_range_subsurface <- range(subsurface_data$pH_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
subsurface_data$pH_scaled <- scale_to_range(subsurface_data$pH_mean, O2_range_subsurface[1], O2_range_subsurface[2])

# Crear gráfico para Surface
plot_surface <- ggplot(surface_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = O2_mean, color = "O2"), method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = pH_scaled, color = "pH"), method = "loess", se = TRUE, span = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Dissolved oxygen (μmol/L)",
    limits = O2_range_surface,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., pH_range_surface[1], pH_range_surface[2], O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2]),
      name = "pH"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  theme_minimal() +
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)

# --- Función para interpolar suavemente ---
interpolate_smooth <- function(data, xvar, yvar, method = "gam", k = 8) {
  form <- as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ s(", xvar, ", k=", k, ", bs='cs')"))
  fit <- gam(form, data = data)
  
  # Crear una secuencia completa de días
  newx <- data.frame(Day = seq(min(data[[xvar]]), max(data[[xvar]]), by = 1))
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = newx, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    Day = newx$Day,
    fit = pred$fit,
    lwr = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
    upr = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
  )
}

# --- Para Surface ---
surface_O2 <- interpolate_smooth(surface_data, "Day", "O2_mean")
surface_pH <- interpolate_smooth(surface_data, "Day", "pH_scaled")

  geom_line(data = surface_O2, aes(x = Day, y = fit, color = "O2"), size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_pH, aes(x = Day, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(data = surface_pH, aes(x = Day, y = fit, color = "pH"), size = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(mgcv)
library(patchwork)

# --- Función para interpolar suavemente con GAM ---
interpolate_smooth <- function(data, xvar, yvar, k = 25, step = 0.1) {
  # Filtrar NA
  data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[xvar]]), !is.na(.data[[yvar]]))
  
  # Evitar error si no hay datos
  if(nrow(data) < 2) return(NULL)
  
  # Ajuste GAM
  form <- as.formula(paste(yvar, "~ s(", xvar, ", k=", k, ", bs='tp')"))
  fit <- gam(form, data = data)
  
  # Predicción
  newx <- data.frame(Day = seq(0, 50, by = step))
  pred <- predict(fit, newdata = newx, se.fit = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    Day = newx$Day,
    fit = pred$fit,
    lwr = pred$fit - 1.96 * pred$se.fit,
    upr = pred$fit + 1.96 * pred$se.fit
  )
}

# --- Función para plotear capa (Surface/Subsurface) ---
plot_layer <- function(data, title) {
  # Rango O2 y pH
  O2_range <- range(data$O2_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  pH_range <- range(data$pH_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Predicciones GAM
  O2_smooth <- interpolate_smooth(data, "Day", "O2_mean")
  pH_smooth <- interpolate_smooth(data, "Day", "pH_mean")
  
  # Escalar pH al rango de O2
  scale_pH_to_O2 <- function(x) {
    (x - min(pH_range)) / (max(pH_range) - min(pH_range)) * (max(O2_range) - min(O2_range)) + min(O2_range)
  }
  unscale_O2_to_pH <- function(x) {
    (x - min(O2_range)) / (max(O2_range) - min(O2_range)) * (max(pH_range) - min(pH_range)) + min(pH_range)
  }
  
  # Plot
  ggplot() +
    # Barras de error O2
    {if(!is.null(O2_smooth)) geom_ribbon(data = O2_smooth, aes(x = Day, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), fill = "red", alpha = 0.2)} +
    # Línea O2
    {if(!is.null(O2_smooth)) geom_line(data = O2_smooth, aes(x = Day, y = fit, color = "O2"), size = 1)} +
    # Barras de error pH
    {if(!is.null(pH_smooth)) geom_ribbon(data = pH_smooth, aes(x = Day, ymin = scale_pH_to_O2(lwr), ymax = scale_pH_to_O2(upr)), 
                fill = "deepskyblue4", alpha = 0.2)} +
    # Línea pH
    {if(!is.null(pH_smooth)) geom_line(data = pH_smooth, aes(x = Day, y = scale_pH_to_O2(fit), color = "pH"), size = 1)} +
    # Escalas
    scale_x_continuous(name = "Days", limits = c(0, 50), breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Dissolved oxygen (μmol/L)",
      limits = O2_range,
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~unscale_O2_to_pH(.), name = "pH")
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
    labs(title = title, color = "") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# --- Generar plots ---
plot_surface <- plot_layer(surface_data, "Surface")
plot_subsurface <- plot_layer(subsurface_data, "Subsurface")

# --- Combinar plots ---
plot_surface / plot_subsurface
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(mgcv)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# --- Calcular promedio y SD por Day y typeset2 ---
o2_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(O2)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(O2_mean = mean(O2, na.rm = TRUE),
            O2_sd   = sd(O2, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(O2_sd = ifelse(is.na(O2_sd), 0, O2_sd)) # si n=1, sd=NA -> 0

pH_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(pH)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(pH_mean = mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
            pH_sd   = sd(pH, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(pH_sd = ifelse(is.na(pH_sd), 0, pH_sd))

# Separar por profundidad
surface_O2    <- o2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_pH    <- pH_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_O2 <- o2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_pH <- pH_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# Funciones de escalado
scale_to_range <- function(x, new_min, new_max, old_min = min(x, na.rm=TRUE), old_max = max(x, na.rm=TRUE)) {
  (x - old_min) / (old_max - old_min) * (new_max - new_min) + new_min
}
unscale_from_range <- function(x, original_min, original_max, scaled_min, scaled_max) {
  (x - scaled_min) / (scaled_max - scaled_min) * (original_max - original_min) + original_min
}

# --- Función que suaviza mean, mean-sd y mean+sd sobre una grilla fina ---
smooth_band <- function(data, day_col, mean_col, sd_col, method = "loess", span = 0.4, k = 8) {
  day_seq <- seq(min(data[[day_col]]), max(data[[day_col]]), length.out = 200)
  d <- data.frame(Day = data[[day_col]],
                   lo  = data[[mean_col]] - data[[sd_col]],
                   mid = data[[mean_col]],
                   hi  = data[[mean_col]] + data[[sd_col]])
  fit_one <- function(y) {
    if (method == "loess") {
      m <- loess(y ~ Day, data = d, span = span)
    } else {
      m <- gam(y ~ s(Day, k = k, bs = "cs"), data = d)
    }
    predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Day = day_seq))
  }
  data.frame(Day = day_seq,
             lo  = fit_one(d$lo),
             mid = fit_one(d$mid),
             hi  = fit_one(d$hi))
}

# --- Generar bandas suavizadas ---
surface_O2_s    <- smooth_band(surface_O2, "Day", "O2_mean", "O2_sd", method = "loess", span = 0.4)
surface_pH_s    <- smooth_band(surface_pH, "Day", "pH_mean", "pH_sd", method = "loess", span = 0.4)
subsurface_O2_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_O2, "Day", "O2_mean", "O2_sd", method = "gam", k = 8)
subsurface_pH_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_pH, "Day", "pH_mean", "pH_sd", method = "gam", k = 8)

# --- Rangos para eje Y (basados en la banda completa, no solo la media) ---
O2_range_surface <- range(c(surface_O2_s$lo, surface_O2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
pH_range_surface <- range(c(surface_pH_s$lo, surface_pH_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

O2_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_O2_s$lo, subsurface_O2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
pH_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_pH_s$lo, subsurface_pH_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Escalar pH (banda completa) al rango de O2 ---
surface_pH_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(surface_pH_s$mid, O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2], pH_range_surface[1], pH_range_surface[2])
surface_pH_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_pH_s$lo,  O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2], pH_range_surface[1], pH_range_surface[2])
surface_pH_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_pH_s$hi,  O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2], pH_range_surface[1], pH_range_surface[2])

subsurface_pH_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(subsurface_pH_s$mid, O2_range_subsurface[1], O2_range_subsurface[2], pH_range_subsurface[1], pH_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_pH_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_pH_s$lo,  O2_range_subsurface[1], O2_range_subsurface[2], pH_range_subsurface[1], pH_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_pH_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_pH_s$hi,  O2_range_subsurface[1], O2_range_subsurface[2], pH_range_subsurface[1], pH_range_subsurface[2])

# --- Gráfico Surface ---
plot_surface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_O2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "O2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_pH_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "pH"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = surface_O2_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "O2"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_pH_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "pH"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("Dissolved oxygen (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., pH_range_surface[1], pH_range_surface[2], O2_range_surface[1], O2_range_surface[2]),
      name = "pH"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface ---
plot_subsurface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_O2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "O2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_pH_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "pH"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_O2_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "O2"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_pH_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "pH"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("Dissolved oxygen (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., pH_range_subsurface[1], pH_range_subsurface[2], O2_range_subsurface[1], O2_range_subsurface[2]),
      name = "pH"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Subsurface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("O2" = "red", "pH" = "deepskyblue4")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

max_first  <- max(e_data$PO4)   # Specify max of first y axis
max_second <- max(e_data$SiO2) # Specify max of second y axis
min_first  <- min(e_data$PO4)   # Specify min of first y axis
min_second <- min(e_data$SiO2) # Specify min of second y axis

# scale and shift variables calculated based on desired mins and maxes
scale <- (max_second - min_second) / (max_first - min_first)
shift <- min_second - min_first * scale

# Function to scale secondary axis
scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return (x * scale + shift)
}

# Function to scale secondary variable values
inv_scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return ((x - shift) / scale)
}
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# Funciones de escalado
scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) x * scale + shift
inv_scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) (x - shift) / scale

# Colores nuevos (sin azul ni naranja)
nutri_colors <- c("PO4" = "#1B9E77", "SiO2" = "#7570B3")  # teal / púrpura
nutri_shapes <- c("PO4" = 16, "SiO2" = 17)

# --- Separar por profundidad ---
surface_data    <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_data <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# --- Escala/shift para Surface ---
max_first_surface  <- max(surface_data$PO4, na.rm = TRUE)
min_first_surface  <- min(surface_data$PO4, na.rm = TRUE)
max_second_surface <- max(surface_data$SiO2, na.rm = TRUE)
min_second_surface <- min(surface_data$SiO2, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_surface <- (max_second_surface - min_second_surface) / (max_first_surface - min_first_surface)
shift_surface <- min_second_surface - min_first_surface * scale_surface

# --- Escala/shift para Subsurface ---
max_first_subsurface  <- max(subsurface_data$PO4, na.rm = TRUE)
min_first_subsurface  <- min(subsurface_data$PO4, na.rm = TRUE)
max_second_subsurface <- max(subsurface_data$SiO2, na.rm = TRUE)
min_second_subsurface <- min(subsurface_data$SiO2, na.rm = TRUE)
scale_subsurface <- (max_second_subsurface - min_second_subsurface) / (max_first_subsurface - min_first_subsurface)
shift_subsurface <- min_second_subsurface - min_first_subsurface * scale_subsurface

# --- Gráfico Surface (4 mesocosmos) ---
plot_surface <- ggplot(surface_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PO4, color = "PO4")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = PO4, shape = "PO4", color = "PO4"), size = 2.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(SiO2, scale_surface, shift_surface), color = "SiO2")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(SiO2, scale_surface, shift_surface), shape = "SiO2", color = "SiO2"), size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ typeset3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(min_first_surface, max_first_surface),
    name = expression(paste("PO"[4], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_surface, shift_surface),
                         name = expression(paste("SiO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutri_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = nutri_shapes) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface (4 mesocosmos) ---
plot_subsurface <- ggplot(subsurface_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = PO4, color = "PO4")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = PO4, shape = "PO4", color = "PO4"), size = 2.5) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(SiO2, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), color = "SiO2")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(SiO2, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), shape = "SiO2", color = "SiO2"), size = 2.5) +
  facet_grid(. ~ typeset3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(min_first_subsurface, max_first_subsurface),
    name = expression(paste("PO"[4], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface),
                         name = expression(paste("SiO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Subsurface", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutri_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = nutri_shapes) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

combined_plot <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
print(combined_plot)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(mgcv)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# --- Promedio y SD por Day y typeset2 ---
calc_mean_sd <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              sd   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(sd = ifelse(is.na(sd), 0, sd))
}

PO4_data  <- calc_mean_sd(e_data, "PO4")
SiO2_data <- calc_mean_sd(e_data, "SiO2")

surface_PO4     <- PO4_data  %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_SiO2    <- SiO2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_PO4  <- PO4_data  %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_SiO2 <- SiO2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# --- Función de suavizado ---
smooth_band <- function(data, method = "loess", span = 0.4, k = 8, day_range = NULL) {
  if (is.null(day_range)) day_range <- range(data$Day)
  day_seq <- seq(day_range[1], day_range[2], length.out = 200)
  d <- data.frame(Day = data$Day, lo = data$mean - data$sd, mid = data$mean, hi = data$mean + data$sd)
  fit_one <- function(y) {
    if (method == "loess") {
      m <- loess(y ~ Day, data = d, span = span, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
    } else {
      m <- gam(y ~ s(Day, k = k, bs = "tp"), data = d, method = "REML", select = FALSE)
    }
    predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Day = day_seq))
  }
  data.frame(Day = day_seq, lo = fit_one(d$lo), mid = fit_one(d$mid), hi = fit_one(d$hi))
}

# --- Generar bandas suavizadas ---
surface_PO4_s     <- smooth_band(surface_PO4, method = "loess", span = 0.4)
surface_SiO2_s    <- smooth_band(surface_SiO2, method = "loess", span = 0.4)
subsurface_PO4_s  <- smooth_band(subsurface_PO4, method = "loess", span = 0.4)   # cambiado a loess
subsurface_SiO2_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_SiO2, method = "loess", span = 0.4)  # cambiado a loess

# --- Rango del eje primario (PO4) con padding ---
pad_range <- function(range_vec, pct = 0.02) {
  span <- diff(range_vec)
  c(range_vec[1] - span * pct, range_vec[2] + span * pct)
}

prim_range_surface    <- pad_range(range(c(surface_PO4_s$lo, surface_PO4_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE))
prim_range_subsurface <- pad_range(range(c(subsurface_PO4_s$lo, subsurface_PO4_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE))

# --- Rango de SiO2 y escala/shift (calculados DESPUÉS del padding) ---
SiO2_range_surface    <- range(c(surface_SiO2_s$lo, surface_SiO2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
SiO2_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_SiO2_s$lo, subsurface_SiO2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

get_scale_shift <- function(target_range, source_range) {
  scale <- (target_range[2] - target_range[1]) / (source_range[2] - source_range[1])
  shift <- target_range[1] - source_range[1] * scale
  list(scale = scale, shift = shift)
}
ss_surface    <- get_scale_shift(prim_range_surface, SiO2_range_surface)
ss_subsurface <- get_scale_shift(prim_range_subsurface, SiO2_range_subsurface)

scale_fwd <- function(x, scale, shift) x * scale + shift
scale_inv <- function(x, scale, shift) (x - shift) / scale

# --- Aplicar transformación a las bandas de SiO2 ---
surface_SiO2_s <- surface_SiO2_s %>%
  mutate(lo_s = scale_fwd(lo, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
         mid_s = scale_fwd(mid, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
         hi_s = scale_fwd(hi, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift))

subsurface_SiO2_s <- subsurface_SiO2_s %>%
  mutate(lo_s = scale_fwd(lo, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
         mid_s = scale_fwd(mid, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
         hi_s = scale_fwd(hi, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift))

# --- Colores ---
nutri_colors <- c("PO4" = "#1B9E77", "SiO2" = "#7570B3")

# --- Gráfico Surface (promedio ± SD) ---
plot_surface_avg <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_PO4_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "PO4"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_SiO2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "SiO2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = surface_PO4_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "PO4"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_SiO2_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "SiO2"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("PO"[4], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    limits = prim_range_surface,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_inv(., ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
                         name = expression(paste("SiO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutri_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nutri_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"), axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface (promedio ± SD) ---
plot_subsurface_avg <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_PO4_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "PO4"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_SiO2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "SiO2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_PO4_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "PO4"), linewidth = 1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +

    limits = prim_range_subsurface,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_inv(., ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
                         name = expression(paste("SiO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +

  )

# --- Combinar ---
```

# nitrate and nitrite

```{r}
e_data <- na.omit(e_data)

library(ggplot2)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

max_first  <- max(e_data$NO3)   # Specify max of first y axis
max_second <- max(e_data$NO2) # Specify max of second y axis
min_first  <- min(e_data$NO3-0.07)   # Specify min of first y axis
min_second <- min(e_data$NO2) # Specify min of second y axis

# scale and shift variables calculated based on desired mins and maxes
scale <- (max_second - min_second) / (max_first - min_first)
shift <- min_second - min_first * scale

# Function to scale secondary axis
scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return (x * scale + shift)
}

# Function to scale secondary variable values
inv_scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) {
  return ((x - shift) / scale)
}
```

```{r}
# Reordenar niveles de typeset2
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# Filtrar los datos para Surface y Subsurface
surface_data <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_data <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# Calcular escala y desplazamiento para Surface
max_first_surface <- max(surface_data$NO3)
min_first_surface <- min(surface_data$NO3 - 0.07)
max_second_surface <- max(surface_data$NO2)
min_second_surface <- min(surface_data$NO2)

scale_surface <- (max_second_surface - min_second_surface) / (max_first_surface - min_first_surface)
shift_surface <- min_second_surface - min_first_surface * scale_surface

# Calcular escala y desplazamiento para Subsurface
max_first_subsurface <- max(subsurface_data$NO3)
min_first_subsurface <- min(subsurface_data$NO3 - 0.07)
max_second_subsurface <- max(subsurface_data$NO2)
min_second_subsurface <- min(subsurface_data$NO2)

scale_subsurface <- (max_second_subsurface - min_second_subsurface) / (max_first_subsurface - min_first_subsurface)
shift_subsurface <- min_second_subsurface - min_first_subsurface * scale_subsurface

# Funciones de escalado
scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) x * scale + shift
inv_scale_function <- function(x, scale, shift) (x - shift) / scale

# Gráfico para Surface
plot_surface <- ggplot(surface_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = NO3, color = "NO3")) +

  geom_point(aes(y = NH4, shape = "NH4", color = "NH4"), size = 3) +

  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(NO2, scale_surface, shift_surface), shape = "NO2", color = "NO2"), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(. ~ typeset3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +

  labs(x = "Days", y = "NO3 (μmol/L)", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NO3" = "lightblue4", "NO2" = "lightsalmon", "NH4" = "red4")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("NO3" = 16, "NO2" = 17, "NH4" = 18)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Gráfico para Subsurface
plot_subsurface <- ggplot(subsurface_data, aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = NO3, color = "NO3")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = NO3, shape = "NO3", color = "NO3"), size = 3) +

  geom_point(aes(y = NH4, shape = "NH4", color = "NH4"), size = 3) +

  facet_grid(. ~ typeset3) +

  labs(x = "Days", y = "NO3 (μmol/L)", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("NO3" = "lightblue4", "NO2" = "lightsalmon", "NH4" = "red4")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("NO3" = 16, "NO2" = 17, "NH4" = 18)) +

# Combinar gráficos
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(mgcv)

# Reordenar niveles de typeset2
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# --- Promedio y SD por Day y typeset2 (cada variable filtrada por separado) ---
calc_mean_sd <- function(data, var) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              sd   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop') %>%
    mutate(sd = ifelse(is.na(sd), 0, sd))
}

NO3_data <- calc_mean_sd(e_data, "NO3")
NH4_data <- calc_mean_sd(e_data, "NH4")
NO2_data <- calc_mean_sd(e_data, "NO2")

# Separar por profundidad
surface_NO3 <- NO3_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_NH4 <- NH4_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_NO2 <- NO2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")

subsurface_NO3 <- NO3_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_NH4 <- NH4_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_NO2 <- NO2_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# --- Función que suaviza mean, mean-sd, mean+sd sobre grilla fina ---
smooth_band <- function(data, method = "loess", span = 0.4, k = 8, day_range = NULL) {
  if (is.null(day_range)) day_range <- range(data$Day)
  day_seq <- seq(day_range[1], day_range[2], length.out = 200)
  d <- data.frame(Day = data$Day, lo = data$mean - data$sd, mid = data$mean, hi = data$mean + data$sd)
  fit_one <- function(y) {
    if (method == "loess") {
      m <- loess(y ~ Day, data = d, span = span, control = loess.control(surface = "direct"))
    } else {
      m <- gam(y ~ s(Day, k = k, bs = "cs"), data = d)
    }
    predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Day = day_seq))
  }
  data.frame(Day = day_seq, lo = fit_one(d$lo), mid = fit_one(d$mid), hi = fit_one(d$hi))
}

# --- Generar bandas suavizadas ---
# Surface: loess para NO3/NH4, gam para NO2 (más estable con su patrón irregular)
surface_NO3_s <- smooth_band(surface_NO3, method = "loess", span = 0.4)
surface_NH4_s <- smooth_band(surface_NH4, method = "loess", span = 0.4)
surface_NO2_s <- smooth_band(surface_NO2, method = "gam", k = 8)

# Subsurface: gam para las tres (igual que en O2/pH)
subsurface_NO3_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_NO3, method = "gam", k = 8)
subsurface_NH4_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_NH4, method = "gam", k = 8)
subsurface_NO2_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_NO2, method = "gam", k = 8)

# --- 1. Rango del eje primario (banda completa de NO3 y NH4) ---
prim_range_surface    <- range(c(surface_NO3_s$lo, surface_NO3_s$hi,
                                  surface_NH4_s$lo, surface_NH4_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
prim_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_NO3_s$lo, subsurface_NO3_s$hi,
                                  subsurface_NH4_s$lo, subsurface_NH4_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- 2. Padding para evitar cortes por redondeo en los bordes ---
pad_range <- function(range_vec, pct = 0.02) {
  span <- diff(range_vec)
  c(range_vec[1] - span * pct, range_vec[2] + span * pct)
}
prim_range_surface    <- pad_range(prim_range_surface)
prim_range_subsurface <- pad_range(prim_range_subsurface)

# --- 3. Rango de NO2 y cálculo de escala/shift usando el rango YA expandido ---
NO2_range_surface    <- range(c(surface_NO2_s$lo, surface_NO2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
NO2_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_NO2_s$lo, subsurface_NO2_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

get_scale_shift <- function(target_range, source_range) {
  scale <- (target_range[2] - target_range[1]) / (source_range[2] - source_range[1])
  shift <- target_range[1] - source_range[1] * scale
  list(scale = scale, shift = shift)
}

ss_surface    <- get_scale_shift(prim_range_surface, NO2_range_surface)
ss_subsurface <- get_scale_shift(prim_range_subsurface, NO2_range_subsurface)

scale_fwd <- function(x, scale, shift) x * scale + shift        # NO2 real -> escala primaria
scale_inv <- function(x, scale, shift) (x - shift) / scale      # escala primaria -> NO2 real

# --- 4. Aplicar transformación a las bandas de NO2 ---
surface_NO2_s <- surface_NO2_s %>%
  mutate(lo_s = scale_fwd(lo, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
         mid_s = scale_fwd(mid, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
         hi_s = scale_fwd(hi, ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift))

subsurface_NO2_s <- subsurface_NO2_s %>%
  mutate(lo_s = scale_fwd(lo, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
         mid_s = scale_fwd(mid, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
         hi_s = scale_fwd(hi, ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift))

# --- Colores consistentes ---
nutrient_colors <- c("NO3" = "lightblue4", "NO2" = "lightsalmon", "NH4" = "red4")

# --- Gráfico Surface ---
plot_surface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_NO3_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "NO3"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_NH4_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "NH4"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_NO2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "NO2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = surface_NO3_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "NO3"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_NH4_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "NH4"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_NO2_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "NO2"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("NO"[3], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    limits = prim_range_surface,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_inv(., ss_surface$scale, ss_surface$shift),
                         name = expression(paste("NO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutrient_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nutrient_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface ---
plot_subsurface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_NO3_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "NO3"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_NH4_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = "NH4"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_NO2_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "NO2"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_NO3_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "NO3"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_NH4_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid, color = "NH4"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_NO2_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "NO2"), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("NO"[3], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")),
    limits = prim_range_subsurface,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_inv(., ss_subsurface$scale, ss_subsurface$shift),
                         name = expression(paste("NO"[2], " (", mu, "mol ", L^-1, ")")))
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Subsurface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = nutrient_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = nutrient_colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Combinar
combined_plot <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
print(combined_plot)
```

#eje independiente
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# --- Paleta actualizada ---
col_chla  <- "palegreen4"  # verde
col_light <- "darkgoldenrod1"  # salmón claro (RdBu)

# --- Función auxiliar: calcula scale/shift para usar con inv_scale_function ---
get_scale_shift <- function(chla_vals, light_vals) {
  min_c <- min(chla_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_c <- max(chla_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  min_l <- min(light_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_l <- max(light_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  scale <- (max_l - min_l) / (max_c - min_c)
  shift <- min_l - min_c * scale
  list(scale = scale, shift = shift, min_c = min_c, max_c = max_c)
}

scale_function     <- function(x, scale, shift) x * scale + shift
inv_scale_function  <- function(x, scale, shift) (x - shift) / scale

# --- Subsets ---
surface_data    <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_data <- e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

ss_surf <- get_scale_shift(surface_data$Chla, surface_data$Light)
ss_sub  <- get_scale_shift(subsurface_data$Chla, subsurface_data$Light)

# --- Función para construir cada panel ---
build_panel <- function(data, ss, xlab = NULL, show_x_labels = TRUE) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Day)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Chla, color = "Chla")) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Chla, shape = "Chla", color = "Chla"), size = 3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Light, ss$scale, ss$shift), color = "Light")) +
    geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Light, ss$scale, ss$shift), shape = "Light", color = "Light"), size = 3) +
    facet_grid(typeset2 ~ typeset3, switch = "y") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), labels = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(ss$min_c, ss$max_c),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ scale_function(., ss$scale, ss$shift), name = "Light intensity (%)")
    ) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = expression(paste("Chla (", mu, "g L"^-1, ")")), color = "", shape = "") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Chla" = col_chla, "Light" = col_light)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Chla" = 16, "Light" = 17)) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = if (show_x_labels) element_text() else element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = if (show_x_labels) element_line() else element_blank()
    )
}

p_surf <- build_panel(surface_data, ss_surf, xlab = NULL, show_x_labels = FALSE)
p_sub  <- build_panel(subsurface_data, ss_sub, xlab = "Days", show_x_labels = TRUE)

nutri_b <- p_surf / p_sub +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

print(nutri_b)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(mgcv)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# --- Colores ---
col_chla  <- "palegreen4"
col_light <- "darkgoldenrod1"

# --- Rango REAL de los datos crudos (para anclar el eje y recortar el suavizado) ---
raw_Light_range_surface    <- range(e_data$Light[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"],    na.rm = TRUE)
raw_Light_range_subsurface <- range(e_data$Light[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"], na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Calcular promedio y SE por Day y typeset2 (los 4 mesocosms juntos) ---
chla_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Chla)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(Chla_mean = mean(Chla, na.rm = TRUE),
            Chla_sd   = sd(Chla, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Chla_sd = ifelse(is.na(Chla_sd), 0, Chla_sd))

light_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Light)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(Light_mean = mean(Light, na.rm = TRUE),
            Light_sd   = sd(Light, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Light_sd = ifelse(is.na(Light_sd), 0, Light_sd))

# --- Separar por profundidad ---
surface_Chla    <- chla_data  %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_Light   <- light_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_Chla  <- chla_data  %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_Light <- light_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# --- Funciones de escalado ---
scale_to_range <- function(x, new_min, new_max, old_min, old_max) {
  (x - old_min) / (old_max - old_min) * (new_max - new_min) + new_min
}
unscale_from_range <- function(x, original_min, original_max, scaled_min, scaled_max) {
  (x - scaled_min) / (scaled_max - scaled_min) * (original_max - original_min) + original_min
}

# --- Función que suaviza mean, mean-sd y mean+sd, y recorta al rango real de los datos crudos ---
smooth_band <- function(data, day_col, mean_col, sd_col, method = "loess", span = 0.4, k = 8,
                         clip_zero = FALSE, raw_range = NULL) {
  day_seq <- seq(min(data[[day_col]]), max(data[[day_col]]), length.out = 200)
  lo_raw <- data[[mean_col]] - data[[sd_col]]
  if (clip_zero) lo_raw <- pmax(lo_raw, 0)
  d <- data.frame(Day = data[[day_col]],
                   lo  = lo_raw,
                   mid = data[[mean_col]],
                   hi  = data[[mean_col]] + data[[sd_col]])
  fit_one <- function(y) {
    if (method == "loess") {
      m <- loess(y ~ Day, data = d, span = span)
    } else {
      m <- gam(y ~ s(Day, k = k, bs = "cs"), data = d)
    }
    predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Day = day_seq))
  }
  out <- data.frame(Day = day_seq,
                     lo  = fit_one(d$lo),
                     mid = fit_one(d$mid),
                     hi  = fit_one(d$hi))
  if (!is.null(raw_range)) {
    out$lo  <- pmin(pmax(out$lo,  raw_range[1]), raw_range[2])
    out$mid <- pmin(pmax(out$mid, raw_range[1]), raw_range[2])
    out$hi  <- pmin(pmax(out$hi,  raw_range[1]), raw_range[2])
  }
  out
}

# --- Generar bandas suavizadas ---
surface_Chla_s     <- smooth_band(surface_Chla,     "Day", "Chla_mean",  "Chla_sd",  method = "loess", span = 0.4)
surface_Light_s    <- smooth_band(surface_Light,    "Day", "Light_mean", "Light_sd", method = "loess", span = 0.4,
                                   clip_zero = TRUE, raw_range = raw_Light_range_surface)
subsurface_Chla_s  <- smooth_band(subsurface_Chla,  "Day", "Chla_mean",  "Chla_sd",  method = "gam", k = 8)
subsurface_Light_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_Light, "Day", "Light_mean", "Light_sd", method = "loess", span = 0.35,
                                   clip_zero = TRUE, raw_range = raw_Light_range_subsurface)

# --- Rangos para eje Y de Chla (basados en la banda completa) ---
Chla_range_surface    <- range(c(surface_Chla_s$lo, surface_Chla_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
Chla_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_Chla_s$lo, subsurface_Chla_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Escalar Light usando el rango REAL de los datos crudos ---
surface_Light_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(surface_Light_s$mid, Chla_range_surface[1], Chla_range_surface[2], raw_Light_range_surface[1], raw_Light_range_surface[2])
surface_Light_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_Light_s$lo,  Chla_range_surface[1], Chla_range_surface[2], raw_Light_range_surface[1], raw_Light_range_surface[2])
surface_Light_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_Light_s$hi,  Chla_range_surface[1], Chla_range_surface[2], raw_Light_range_surface[1], raw_Light_range_surface[2])

subsurface_Light_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Light_s$mid, Chla_range_subsurface[1], Chla_range_subsurface[2], raw_Light_range_subsurface[1], raw_Light_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_Light_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Light_s$lo,  Chla_range_subsurface[1], Chla_range_subsurface[2], raw_Light_range_subsurface[1], raw_Light_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_Light_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Light_s$hi,  Chla_range_subsurface[1], Chla_range_subsurface[2], raw_Light_range_subsurface[1], raw_Light_range_subsurface[2])

# --- Gráfico Surface ---
plot_surface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_Chla_s,  aes(x = Day, ymin = lo,   ymax = hi,   fill  = "Chla"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_Light_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill  = "Light"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = surface_Chla_s,  aes(x = Day, y = mid,   color = "Chla"),  linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_Light_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "Light"), linewidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = Chla_range_surface) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("Chla (", mu, "g L"^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., raw_Light_range_surface[1], raw_Light_range_surface[2], Chla_range_surface[1], Chla_range_surface[2]),
      name = "Light intensity (%)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Chla" = col_chla, "Light" = col_light)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chla" = col_chla, "Light" = col_light)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface ---
plot_subsurface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_Chla_s,  aes(x = Day, ymin = lo,   ymax = hi,   fill  = "Chla"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_Light_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill  = "Light"), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_Chla_s,  aes(x = Day, y = mid,   color = "Chla"),  linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_Light_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "Light"), linewidth = 1) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = Chla_range_subsurface) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = expression(paste("Chla (", mu, "g L"^-1, ")")),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., raw_Light_range_subsurface[1], raw_Light_range_subsurface[2], Chla_range_subsurface[1], Chla_range_subsurface[2]),
      name = "Light intensity (%)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Subsurface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Chla" = col_chla, "Light" = col_light)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Chla" = col_chla, "Light" = col_light)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

combined_plot <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface
print(combined_plot)
```

```{r}
# Cargar las librerías necesarias
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Asegurarse de que los niveles de "typeset2" estén en el orden correcto
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# Definir límites específicos para cada capa
max_first_surface  <- max(e_data$Salinity[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
min_first_surface  <- min(e_data$Salinity[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
max_second_surface <- max(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])
min_second_surface <- min(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"])

max_first_subsurface  <- max(e_data$Salinity[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
min_first_subsurface  <- min(e_data$Salinity[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
max_second_subsurface <- max(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])
min_second_subsurface <- min(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"])

# Calcular escala y desplazamiento para cada capa
scale_surface <- (max_second_surface - min_second_surface) / (max_first_surface - min_first_surface)
shift_surface <- min_second_surface - min_first_surface * scale_surface

scale_subsurface <- (max_second_subsurface - min_second_subsurface) / (max_first_subsurface - min_first_subsurface)
shift_subsurface <- min_second_subsurface - min_first_subsurface * scale_subsurface

# Crear gráfico para Surface
plot_surface <- ggplot(e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface"), aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Salinity, color = "Salinity")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Salinity, shape = "Salinity", color = "Salinity"), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~typeset3, ncol = 4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Temp, scale_surface, shift_surface), color = "Temp")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Temp, scale_surface, shift_surface), shape = "Temp", color = "Temp"), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), labels = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_first_surface, max_first_surface), sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_surface, shift_surface), name = "Temperature (°C)")) +
  labs(x = "Days", y = "Salinity", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salinity" = "lightskyblue4", "Temp" = "lightsalmon")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Salinity" = 16, "Temp" = 17)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Crear gráfico para Subsurface
plot_subsurface <- ggplot(e_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface"), aes(x = Day)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Salinity, color = "Salinity")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Salinity, shape = "Salinity", color = "Salinity"), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~typeset3, ncol = 4) +
  geom_line(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Temp, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), color = "Temp")) +
  geom_point(aes(y = inv_scale_function(Temp, scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), shape = "Temp", color = "Temp"), size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), labels = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(min_first_subsurface, max_first_subsurface), sec.axis = sec_axis(~scale_function(., scale_subsurface, shift_subsurface), name = "Temperature (°C)")) +
  labs(x = "Days", y = "Salinity", color = "", shape = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salinity" = "lightskyblue4", "Temp" = "lightsalmon")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Salinity" = 16, "Temp" = 17)) +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Combinar gráficos
pkpd_combined <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface
print(pkpd_combined)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

# Reordenar los niveles de la columna "typeset2"
e_data$typeset2 <- factor(e_data$typeset2, levels = c("Surface", "Subsurface"))

# --- Colores ---
col_salinity <- "#053061"
col_temp     <- "#D6604D"

# --- Rango REAL de los datos crudos (ancla el eje secundario) ---
raw_Temp_range_surface    <- range(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Surface"],    na.rm = TRUE)
raw_Temp_range_subsurface <- range(e_data$Temp[e_data$typeset2 == "Subsurface"], na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Calcular promedio y SD por Day y typeset2 (los 4 mesocosms juntos) ---
salinity_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Salinity)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(Salinity_mean = mean(Salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
            Salinity_sd   = sd(Salinity, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Salinity_sd = ifelse(is.na(Salinity_sd), 0, Salinity_sd)) %>%
  arrange(Day)

temp_data <- e_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Temp)) %>%
  group_by(Day, typeset2) %>%
  summarise(Temp_mean = mean(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            Temp_sd   = sd(Temp, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop') %>%
  mutate(Temp_sd = ifelse(is.na(Temp_sd), 0, Temp_sd)) %>%
  arrange(Day)

# --- Separar por profundidad ---
surface_Salinity    <- salinity_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
surface_Temp        <- temp_data     %>% filter(typeset2 == "Surface")
subsurface_Salinity <- salinity_data %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")
subsurface_Temp     <- temp_data     %>% filter(typeset2 == "Subsurface")

# --- Funciones de escalado ---
scale_to_range <- function(x, new_min, new_max, old_min, old_max) {
  (x - old_min) / (old_max - old_min) * (new_max - new_min) + new_min
}
unscale_from_range <- function(x, original_min, original_max, scaled_min, scaled_max) {
  (x - scaled_min) / (scaled_max - scaled_min) * (original_max - original_min) + original_min
}

# --- Suavizado LIVIANO (span bajo) que respeta transiciones abruptas reales (day 13 y 33) ---
smooth_band <- function(data, day_col, mean_col, sd_col, span = 0.15) {
  day_seq <- seq(min(data[[day_col]]), max(data[[day_col]]), length.out = 200)
  d <- data.frame(Day = data[[day_col]],
                   lo  = data[[mean_col]] - data[[sd_col]],
                   mid = data[[mean_col]],
                   hi  = data[[mean_col]] + data[[sd_col]])
  fit_one <- function(y) {
    m <- loess(y ~ Day, data = d, span = span)
    predict(m, newdata = data.frame(Day = day_seq))
  }
  data.frame(Day = day_seq, lo = fit_one(d$lo), mid = fit_one(d$mid), hi = fit_one(d$hi))
}

# --- Generar bandas suavizadas ---
surface_Salinity_s    <- smooth_band(surface_Salinity,    "Day", "Salinity_mean", "Salinity_sd", span = 0.15)
surface_Temp_s        <- smooth_band(surface_Temp,        "Day", "Temp_mean",     "Temp_sd",     span = 0.15)
subsurface_Salinity_s <- smooth_band(subsurface_Salinity, "Day", "Salinity_mean", "Salinity_sd", span = 0.15)
subsurface_Temp_s     <- smooth_band(subsurface_Temp,     "Day", "Temp_mean",     "Temp_sd",     span = 0.15)

# --- Rangos para eje Y de Salinity (basados en la banda completa) ---
Salinity_range_surface    <- range(c(surface_Salinity_s$lo, surface_Salinity_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)
Salinity_range_subsurface <- range(c(subsurface_Salinity_s$lo, subsurface_Salinity_s$hi), na.rm = TRUE)

# --- Escalar Temp usando el rango REAL de los datos crudos ---
surface_Temp_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(surface_Temp_s$mid, Salinity_range_surface[1], Salinity_range_surface[2], raw_Temp_range_surface[1], raw_Temp_range_surface[2])
surface_Temp_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_Temp_s$lo,  Salinity_range_surface[1], Salinity_range_surface[2], raw_Temp_range_surface[1], raw_Temp_range_surface[2])
surface_Temp_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(surface_Temp_s$hi,  Salinity_range_surface[1], Salinity_range_surface[2], raw_Temp_range_surface[1], raw_Temp_range_surface[2])

subsurface_Temp_s$mid_s <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Temp_s$mid, Salinity_range_subsurface[1], Salinity_range_subsurface[2], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[1], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_Temp_s$lo_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Temp_s$lo,  Salinity_range_subsurface[1], Salinity_range_subsurface[2], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[1], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[2])
subsurface_Temp_s$hi_s  <- scale_to_range(subsurface_Temp_s$hi,  Salinity_range_subsurface[1], Salinity_range_subsurface[2], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[1], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[2])

# --- Gráfico Surface ---
plot_surface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_Salinity_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo,   ymax = hi,   fill = "Salinity"), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_ribbon(data = surface_Temp_s,     aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "Temp"), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_line(data = surface_Salinity_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid,   color = "Salinity"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = surface_Temp_s,     aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "Temp"),     linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(13, 33), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = Salinity_range_surface) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Salinity",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., raw_Temp_range_surface[1], raw_Temp_range_surface[2], Salinity_range_surface[1], Salinity_range_surface[2]),
      name = "Temperature (°C)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Surface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salinity" = col_salinity, "Temp" = col_temp)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Salinity" = col_salinity, "Temp" = col_temp)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# --- Gráfico Subsurface ---
plot_subsurface <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_Salinity_s, aes(x = Day, ymin = lo,   ymax = hi,   fill = "Salinity"), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subsurface_Temp_s,     aes(x = Day, ymin = lo_s, ymax = hi_s, fill = "Temp"), alpha = 0.55) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_Salinity_s, aes(x = Day, y = mid,   color = "Salinity"), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = subsurface_Temp_s,     aes(x = Day, y = mid_s, color = "Temp"),     linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(13, 33), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = Salinity_range_subsurface) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 50, 10), limits = c(0, 50), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Salinity",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      trans = ~unscale_from_range(., raw_Temp_range_subsurface[1], raw_Temp_range_subsurface[2], Salinity_range_subsurface[1], Salinity_range_subsurface[2]),
      name = "Temperature (°C)"
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "Days", title = "Subsurface", color = "", fill = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Salinity" = col_salinity, "Temp" = col_temp)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Salinity" = col_salinity, "Temp" = col_temp)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

combined_plot <- plot_surface / plot_subsurface
print(combined_plot)
```
